ventilo.title: ventilo.ca

ventiloApp.description3: Automated releases, regulatory compliance, behaviour analytics

portfolio.openSourceFooter: Both live in <repo>one repository</repo>, share a common crate, and install with a single command.

macroTui.title: macro-tui
macroTui.lead: Twenty-six macro instruments on one screen: indices, Treasury yields, commodities, currencies and crypto, with the headlines moving them.
macroTui.description1: Live prices and a month of daily closes per row, from <mark>public keyless feeds</mark>, so there is nothing to sign up for and nothing to configure
macroTui.description2: Recomputes every move from the prices rather than trusting the vendor's own field, which <mark>reports the wrong sign</mark> for short-dated Treasuries
macroTui.description3: One <mark>static binary</mark> under 2 MB, rendering to stderr so it stays pipeable, with charts scaled to the data instead of anchored at zero

nhlTui.title: nhl-tui
nhlTui.lead: Live NHL scores, the wild card race, the schedule and the scoring leaders, with the full boxscore a keypress away.
nhlTui.description1: Goals, assists, penalties and the three stars <mark>period by period</mark>, straight from the league's own public API
nhlTui.description2: Navigation that <mark>lands on days with games</mark>, rather than following the API's week pointer past them
nhlTui.description3: Ships to five platforms from one tag, with a <mark>checksum beside every archive</mark> and a Homebrew formula kept in step

resume.title: CV
resume.name: Jean-Philippe Melanson
resume.availability: Part-time · remote from Québec · travel when it matters
resume.overviewText: The engineer companies hand the critical path to: technical co-founder of a real-estate platform, protocol engineer on a token launch, consultant inside Ticketmaster's live-event systems. I work autonomously, ship on the date I gave you, and tell you the truth about scope, risk and cost, early. Since 2024 I ship with AI coding agents and set teams up to do the same.
resume.outcome1T: doormath.ca — built the company's technical foundation as technical co-founder.
resume.outcome1D: Architecture, product and infrastructure from zero to MVP; onboarded the first 10–20 paying customers.
resume.outcome2T: Sapien — shipped the Proof of Quality protocol from design to token launch (Aug 2025).
resume.outcome2D: Incentives, quality control and rewards, in a team of eight senior engineers, on a platform past 1M contributors and 100M tasks.
resume.outcome3T: Ticketmaster — owned the worst incident on the NFL admission platform.
resume.outcome3D: Live database corruption was showing wrong entry status at games; found the bug, reconciled production data, shipped the fix.
resume.outcome4T: CRIUCPQ — led a research hospital's scientific app from two native apps to one React Native codebase and the web.
resume.outcome4D: Roughly halved the yearly maintenance effort: one language, one release train, both stores plus web.
resume.outcome5T: FastAF — carried the backend and delivery of core commerce and crypto-payment features.
resume.outcome5D: Thousands of transactions a day; DevOps and QA automation that cut support tickets ~40% and tripled deploy frequency.

sapien.title: Senior Software Engineer
sapien.description1: Designed and shipped the Proof of Quality protocol — incentives and quality control for AI training-data labelling — through the August 2025 token launch.
sapien.description2: Built token distribution and goal-based rewards on the protocol, powering airdrops and paying for high-quality work.
sapien.description3: Set up AI-agent-driven development for the team — code-quality automations, reporting, a product-first backlog — and mentored engineers on the practice.

doormath.title: Technical Co-founder
doormath.description1: Owned the technical foundation of a real-estate platform — instant home valuations and market analytics — in Next.js, TypeScript and Supabase/Postgres.
doormath.description2: Set product vision and roadmap with the CEO; coordinated UX designers and ML engineers.
doormath.description3: Delivered 15+ core features and the production infrastructure behind them: 99.9% uptime, sub-2 s loads, first paying customers.
